confidence_notes: Overall low. Inexpensive meal and cappuccino rest on July 2026 aggregator figures, some citing Numbeo. Mid-range meal sits between a Numbeo Chennai figure surfaced in search (INR 1,450) and lower aggregator figures (INR 800 to 1,000). Beer is set just above aggregator draught figures (INR 170 to 180) to allow for bar markups. No Chennai cocktail or wine-by-glass price was found, so cocktail is about 2x and wine_glass about 1.8x the beer anchor, a general assumption. Hostel and hotel anchors are general-knowledge model estimates; no accommodation search or live listing was checked. INR is converted at about 95 per USD, an unverified assumption implied by one 2026 aggregator. FX is the only RBA observation found (2026-03-20, RBA exchange-rates page surfaced by search); it is about eight months old and may not be the latest. Third-party November quotes were not used because they are not RBA data.
comparable_city_reasoning: No named comparable city. Food anchors use Chennai-specific 2026 aggregator figures; accommodation anchors are general South Asian metro-level estimates; cocktail and wine_glass are ratios to the beer anchor.
